title: Pair multiple Lasso devices to a single iPhone
body:
You can pair your iPhone to two Lasso devices. When your alarm rings, you will be able to scan either device to stop it.

This is useful if you frequently spend the night somewhere else or you like to keep an extra device in your travel bag.

To pair to an additional device, open the Lasso app’s Settings > Device menu, then tap the ‘Add Device’ button at the bottom of the screen.
